sources.source: Domestic abuse prevalence and victim characteristics
sources.verified_fact: The current year-ending-March-2025 edition was released 26 November 2025 and combines CSEW and police-recorded evidence on prevalence, abuse types and victim characteristics.
sources.quality_effect: Adds national victimisation and characteristic context while forbidding survey or police-force aggregates from being converted into parcel probabilities or individual inference.

sources.source: Domestic abuse and the criminal justice system
sources.verified_fact: The November 2025 edition was released 26 November 2025 and brings together cross-government information on responses to and outcomes of domestic-abuse cases.
sources.quality_effect: Adds criminal-justice pathway context; arrests, referrals and outcomes remain separate from incident prevalence, severity and parcel safety.

sources.source: Domestic abuse in England and Wales data tool
sources.verified_fact: The year-ending-March-2025 police-force-area comparison tool was released 26 November 2025 and corrected 7 January 2026 after a City of London comparison fault.
sources.quality_effect: Adds an explicit correction/read-version guard so superseded police-area comparisons are not reused.

sources.verified_fact: The official collection includes selected VAWG offence subcodes from year ending March 2021 to year ending December 2025, added in the 23 April 2026 update.
sources.quality_effect: Adds a nationally consistent offence-subcode cross-check while preventing sensitive aggregate categories from being used for individual or parcel inference.

sources.source: The nature of violent crime appendix tables: year ending March 2026
sources.verified_fact: The accredited-statistics release is provisionally scheduled for 22 October 2026 and will cover CSEW violence and harassment plus police-recorded violence and sexual offences; it is not published at this check.
sources.quality_effect: Prevents unpublished future tables or figures from being invented, backfilled or treated as current evidence.

quality_guards: AREA_LEVEL_PROXY only; no parcel measurement claim.
Domestic-abuse survey and police-force aggregates are not parcel probabilities or individual inference.
Criminal-justice responses and outcomes are not incident prevalence or severity weights.
The domestic-abuse PFA tool must use the corrected 7 January 2026 version.
VAWG offence subcodes remain sensitive aggregate cross-checks.
The October 2026 violent-crime appendix release is unpublished and cannot supply current values.
No existing candidate score or stored parcel value was modified.
